I added a formatting toolbar to the custom declaration form. I haven't run the app or any tests, so none of it has been exercised. The only check was a Ruby syntax check on the edited file. All changes are in `app/helpers/reports_helper.rb`.

- **Buttons:** The declaration text box now has a row of buttons above it for bold, italic, underline, centered and justified. Each one wraps the selected text in the matching tag (`<b>`, `<i>`, `<u>`, `<center>`, `<justify>`). Users don't have to type the tags themselves.
- **PDF output:** The PDF now applies those tags. Bold, italic and underline go through Prawn's inline formatting. Text inside `<center>` or `<justify>` gets that alignment. Text outside any tag is justified, as before. `<left>` and `<right>` also work if typed by hand, but there are no buttons for them.
- **Nesting:** Alignment tags can't be nested inside each other.
- **Existing text:** Declarations written earlier with a literal `<` or `&` may now render differently, because the text is now read as inline formatting.

I understood "declarações customizáveis" to mean the declaration form under Reports (`reports_helper.rb`), not the report configurations or email templates, which use other editors.
